title: Rutting Moose Audio Clip (Denali National Park & Preserve)
author: NPS Media / Richard Nelson
changes: A cow moose (Alces alces) giving her nasal, bawling call during the autumn rut in Denali National Park, Alaska. Trimmed to 9.60–11.50 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 200 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. US National Park Service recording. The high-pass removes the measured wind rumble that dominates the recording below 200 Hz.
